        <payload><?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>true</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>true</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Modifier des accès SAP - Nouveau consultant">b7274802878bca507f7d20e5cebb358f</cat_item><cat_variable/><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Adapt to new consultant context</name><order>300</order><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onLoad() {
   
	//Adjust field properties according to the new consultant context

	//Arrivals mean we do not know the person yet, so many variables and options don't apply
	g_form.setValue('sap_request', 'sap_request_temporary_access'); //set a default for the arrival scenario
	g_form.setValue('sap_request_temporary_access_start_date', g_form.getValue('date_arrivee_employe'));
	g_form.setValue('sap_request_temporary_access_end_date', g_form.getValue('date_fin_mandat'));
	g_form.removeOption('sap_request', 'sap_request_employee_movement'); //Prevent using this option for arrivals 
	//g_form.setReadOnly('sap_request', true);
	g_form.setVisible('sap_request_role_remove', false); //Can't remove roles if not arrived yet
	g_form.setVisible('sap_request_new_need_for', false); //Need is for the new employee
	g_form.setVisible('sap_request_user', false); //User is new, not yet defined
	g_form.setVisible('sap_request_position', false); //Not needed?
	//Variables below come from "EN - Consultant - Infos" Variable set, hide some of them
	g_form.setVisible('computer_informations', false);
	g_form.setVisible('this_profile_include', false);
	g_form.setVisible('repartiteur', false);
	g_form.setVisible('besoins_ordinateur', false);
	g_form.setVisible('computer_type_consultant', false);
	g_form.setVisible('personal_computer', false);
	g_form.setVisible('ordinateur_nom', false);
	g_form.setVisible('cost_center', false);
	g_form.setVisible('work_schedule', false);
	g_form.setVisible('windows_profile_as', false);
	//Set the ones we keep as read-only
	g_form.setReadOnly('emp_deja_gazmetro', true);
	g_form.setReadOnly('new_employee_details', true);
	g_form.setReadOnly('emp_type', true);
	g_form.setReadOnly('emp_prenom', true);
	g_form.setReadOnly('emp_title', true);
	g_form.setReadOnly('position_title', true);
	g_form.setReadOnly('emp_nom', true);
	g_form.setReadOnly('emp_emplacement', true);
	g_form.setReadOnly('emp_departement', true);
	g_form.setReadOnly('newemp_superieur', true);
	g_form.setReadOnly('date_fin_mandat', true);
	g_form.setReadOnly('date_arrivee_employe', true);
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>bcrepeault_admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2024-06-28 13:15:17</sys_created_on><sys_customer_update>false</sys_customer_update><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>7327c882878bca507f7d20e5cebb356a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Adapt to new consultant context</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_replace_on_upgrade>false</sys_replace_on_upgrade><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_7327c882878bca507f7d20e5cebb356a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>bcrepeault_admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2024-06-28 13:43:15</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onLoad</type><u_fx_inactive>false</u_fx_inactive><u_source/><u_target/><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update></payload>
